name: Outlier-pool recovery trade
hypothesis: Buy the outlier only after its price begins recovering while multiple independent reference routes remain stable.
spec: Setup: A pool-specific sell shock may revert toward an unaffected consensus. Entry: Buy the outlier only after its price begins recovering while multiple independent reference routes remain stable. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit at consensus convergence or a new downside shock. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs synchronized multi-pool DEX quotes (not connected)
